answer.rationale: memory_c2 confirms the low-cost vendor's onboarding and invoicing accuracy were strong last cycle, supporting the switch decision. Finance's 18% cut mandate, the incumbent's refusal to reopen price, and the vendor's quote meeting the mandate alone make switching the lowest-cost path. Because the line runs at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, I'd stage a short parallel-run before the 14-day expiry so a delivery miss on the new source doesn't halt the line. memory_c1's incumbent stability and memory_c6's volume-pricing gains are real but don't offset the mandate if the new vendor's quote clears it.
